count_laureates.description: Count the laureates matching a filter without fetching them all: how many women have won the Physics prize, how many laureates were born in a country, how many motivations mention a subject. Returns the total and one example.
count_laureates.name: count_laureates

parameters.description: Count laureates of one gender. Organizations have none, so setting this leaves them out.
parameters.name: gender

parameters.description: Count laureates of one prize category.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Count laureates awarded a prize in this year. With Prize end year set, this starts a range.
parameters.name: prize_year

parameters.description: The last year of a prize-year range. Only narrows a range, so Prize year is required alongside it.
parameters.name: prize_year_to

parameters.description: Count laureates born in this country, named as it was at the time.
parameters.name: birth_country

parameters.description: Count laureates born on this continent.
parameters.name: birth_continent

parameters.description: Count laureates whose motivation contains this text.
parameters.name: motivation

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

find_laureates_by_name.description: Find the laureates whose name contains the search text. This is how a workflow turns a name into the numeric ID that Get a laureate takes.

prizes.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect

find_laureates_by_name.name: find_laureates_by_name

parameters.description: Text the laureate's name contains. Matches people and organizations.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: How many laureates to return (1-100). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many matching records to skip before collecting results. Use it with Number of results to page through a large search.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

find_laureates_by_place.description: Find laureates by where they were born or died, or where an organization was founded or is headquartered. Pick which of those the country, city and continent apply to; at least one of the three is required.

prizes.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect

find_laureates_by_place.name: find_laureates_by_place

parameters.description: Which place the country, city and continent refer to. Defaults to place of birth.
parameters.name: place_kind

parameters.description: The country's name as it was at the time, such as 'Japan' or 'Prussia'.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: The city's name as it was at the time.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: The continent, as geonames.org names them.
parameters.name: continent

parameters.description: Narrow to laureates of one prize category.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: How many laureates to return (1-100). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many matching records to skip before collecting results. Use it with Number of results to page through a large search.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

get_latest_prizes.description: Get the most recently awarded Nobel Prizes, newest year first, optionally narrowed to one category. This is the "who just won?" question, with no year to fill in.

laureates.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect
laureates.name: Albert Einstein

get_latest_prizes.name: get_latest_prizes

parameters.description: Narrow to one category, to get that category's most recent prizes. Leave blank for all of them.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: How many prizes to return (1-100). Defaults to 6, one award year's worth.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

get_laureate.description: Get one laureate's full record by their numeric ID: their biography or founding details, links to Wikipedia and Wikidata, and every prize they have won with its motivation and their share of it.

prizes.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect

get_laureate.name: get_laureate

parameters.description: The laureate's numeric ID, as returned by any of the search actions.
parameters.name: laureate_id

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

get_prize.description: Get one Nobel Prize by the category and year that identify it, with its laureates, their shares of the prize and their motivations. For the winners' full biographies, use Get the laureates of a prize instead.
get_prize.display_str_template: Get the Nobel Prize in {0} for {1}.

laureates.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect
laureates.name: Albert Einstein

get_prize.name: get_prize

parameters.description: Which of the six prize categories to get.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: The award year, as YYYY.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

get_prize_laureates.description: Get the full record of everyone who shared one Nobel Prize: their biography, where they were born, the institution they worked at, and every other prize they have won. Each record also carries the single prize entry this category and year refer to.
get_prize_laureates.display_name: Get the laureates of a prize

prize.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect

prizes.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect

get_prize_laureates.name: get_prize_laureates

parameters.description: Which of the six prize categories to look up.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: The award year, as YYYY.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

get_prizes_by_year.description: Get every Nobel Prize awarded in one year, across all six categories, in a single step. Categories that were not awarded that year are still returned, flagged as not awarded with the Nobel Foundation's explanation.
get_prizes_by_year.display_name: Get the prizes of a year

laureates.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect
laureates.name: Albert Einstein

get_prizes_by_year.name: get_prizes_by_year

parameters.description: The award year, as YYYY. The first Nobel Prizes were awarded in 1901; the Economic Sciences prize starts in 1969.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

get_prizes_by_year.result_str_template: Nobel Prizes for the year retrieved.

search_laureates.description: Search Nobel Prize laureates, people and organizations alike, by name, gender, motivation text, affiliation, residence, birth or death date, and the year and category of the prize. Every filter is optional and they combine, so "women awarded the Physics prize" is one call.

prizes.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect

search_laureates.name: search_laureates

parameters.description: Text the laureate's name contains. Organizations match on their name too.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Narrow to laureates of one gender. Organizations have none, so setting this leaves them out.
parameters.name: gender

parameters.description: Text the Nobel committee's motivation contains, such as 'DNA' or 'human rights'.
parameters.name: motivation

parameters.description: The institution the laureate belonged to when the prize was awarded, such as a university.
parameters.name: affiliation

parameters.description: Where the laureate was living when the prize was awarded.
parameters.name: residence

parameters.description: A year (1867), a month across all years (-11-), a day of the month (-07), or a full date (1867-11-07).
parameters.name: birth_date

parameters.description: The end of a birth-date range. Only narrows a range, so Born is required alongside it.
parameters.name: birth_date_to

parameters.description: Same forms as Born: a year, a month, a day of the month, or a full date.
parameters.name: death_date

parameters.description: The end of a death-date range. Only narrows a range, so Died is required alongside it.
parameters.name: death_date_to

parameters.description: Narrow to laureates awarded a prize in this year. With Prize end year set, this starts a range.
parameters.name: prize_year

parameters.description: The last year of a prize-year range. Only narrows a range, so Prize year is required alongside it.
parameters.name: prize_year_to

parameters.description: Narrow to laureates of one prize category.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Sort alphabetically by the laureate's known name, ascending or descending.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: How many laureates to return (1-100). Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many matching records to skip before collecting results. Use it with Number of results to page through a large search.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Which language to return names, categories and motivations in. Defaults to English; a field the Nobel Foundation has not translated falls back to English.
parameters.name: language

search_prizes.description: Search the Nobel Prizes awarded since 1901 by year, year range and category. Every filter is optional, so with none set this pages through the whole history. Each prize comes back with its laureates' names, shares and motivations.

laureates.motivation: for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect
laureates.name: Albert Einstein

search_prizes.name: search_prizes

parameters.description: The year the prize was awarded, as YYYY. With End year set, this is the start of a range.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: The last year of a range, as YYYY. Only narrows a range, so Year is required alongside it.
parameters.name: year_to

parameters.description: Narrow to one of the six prize categories. Leave blank for all of them.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Sort by award year, oldest or newest first.

parameters.description: How many prizes to return (1-100). Defaults to 25.

description: Look up every Nobel Prize and Nobel laureate since 1901 from the Nobel Foundation's own open data: search the prizes by year and category, get one prize or one year's full slate, and search laureates by name, gender, motivation, affiliation, dates, or where they were born. No account or API key required.
